title: ‘This is hell’: British widow ‘sick’ with worry after losing Brexit deportation appeal

paragraphs.en: The 78-year-old British widow threatened with removal from Sweden after 21 years has said she has been left feeling sick with worry after being told she had lost an appeal against deportation in a growing row over the country’s handling of Brexit.
paragraphs.zh: 这位78岁的英国寡妇在瑞典生活21年后面临被驱逐出境的威胁。在围绕瑞典处理英国脱欧问题日益激烈的争议中，她在得知驱逐上诉败诉后表示，自己因担忧而病倒了。

paragraphs.en: “I am in shock. I feel sick. An individual’s life is at stake at my age. It is hell. I have done nothing wrong. I don’t take anything from this country. I am self sufficient, I put money in this country, have no criminal record,” said Joyce Thomas from her home in Sweden on Thursday.
paragraphs.zh: 周四，乔伊斯·托马斯在瑞典的家中说：“我震惊不已，感到恶心。在我这个年纪，一个人的生命危在旦夕。这简直像地狱。我没有做错任何事。我没有从这个国家拿走任何东西。我自食其力，把钱投入这个国家，没有犯罪记录。”

paragraphs.en: Her plight, first revealed by the Guardian, has raised concerns in Brussels and in the UK about Sweden’s approach to the EU-UK withdrawal agreement, which was supposed to protect British nationals who lived in an EU member state before Brexit.
paragraphs.zh: 她的困境最初由《卫报》披露，此事已在布鲁塞尔和英国引发人们对瑞典处理《欧盟-英国脱欧协议》方式的担忧。该协议本应保护脱欧前居住在欧盟成员国的英国公民。

paragraphs.en: Earlier this week another family told how their father, a dementia patient in full-time care, was also threatened with removal after 25 years in Sweden.
paragraphs.zh: 本周早些时候，另一个家庭讲述了他们的父亲——一名接受全天候护理的失智症患者——在瑞典生活25年后，也面临被驱逐出境的威胁。

paragraphs.en: The administrative court in Luleå upheld Sweden’s migration agency decision that Thomas was not eligible to stay because her application was made in 2023, after the cut-off date of December 2021.
paragraphs.zh: 吕勒奥行政法院维持了瑞典移民局的裁决，即托马斯不符合居留资格，因为她的申请是在2023年提出的，晚于2021年12月的截止日期。

paragraphs.en: Her legal representatives told the court in Luleå it was “not proportionate for her to be deported solely because she missed a deadline due to insufficient information. Furthermore, it is not acceptable that the Swedish authorities failed to inform her that she needed to file an application and of the deadline by which it was to be filed.”
paragraphs.zh: 她的法律代表向吕勒奥法院表示，“仅仅因为她因信息不足而错过了截止日期就将其驱逐出境，是不成比例的。此外，瑞典当局未能告知她需要提交申请以及提交申请的截止日期，这也是不可接受的。”

paragraphs.en: Thomas now faces the prospect of a letter from the migration agency giving her four weeks to leave voluntarily , separating her from her son, her grandchildren, her network of friends, and away from her husband’s grave, which she regularly visits.
paragraphs.zh: 托马斯现在面临这样的前景：移民局的信件将给她四周时间自愿离开，使她与儿子、孙子孙女、朋友圈子分离，并离开她经常祭扫的丈夫的墓地。

paragraphs.en: If she fails to comply, not only will she face a forced deportation, but the court of appeal has told her she could face a “re-entry ban” and “registered on a watchlist” preventing entry into a Schengen country, which includes Sweden “as long as the re-entry ban remains in effect”.
paragraphs.zh: 如果她不遵守，不仅将面临强制驱逐，上诉法院还告诉她，她可能面临“再入境禁令”并被“列入监视名单”，只要该禁令仍然有效，她将被禁止进入包括瑞典在内的申根国家。
